description: semanticId hashes kind + name + normalised signature. Two functions with the same name and signature in different files produce the same ID. File/module nodes special-case this by including filePath. Other node kinds (function, class, variable) do not — relying on the assumption that identical signatures in different files represent the same logical entity. This assumption breaks for common names like init, handle, process in unrelated modules.
label: Semantic ID Collision

members.note: Does not include filePath for non-file kinds. Collision possible for common function names with identical signatures.
Special-cases file/module kinds. All other kinds hash without location.
Consumes semantic IDs. A collision would merge two unrelated nodes into one, producing phantom modify_node ops or missing add/remove pairs.
